headline: Code Changes & Accelerated Review goes before Town Council on Tuesday, August 11
blurb: The most consequential item on this agenda is third reading of the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code — if approved, it amends the Land Use Code's historic and architectural review standards and landscaping/tree maintenance rules to align with state wildfire mitigation requirements. That's the kind of code change that quietly reshapes what property owners can and can't do with vegetation and building materials for years to come.
